notes: IFSC Banking Unit in GIFT City

gap_classification.notes: JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A. GIFT City branch (jpmorgan.com/IN/en/about-us/gift-city) is explicitly wholesale/institutional only - serves overseas subsidiaries of Indian companies, non-resident MNEs, financial institutions and multilateral agencies. Product set is Markets (FX/IRS/debt) and Lending; no deposit/FD product with published public rates. IBU deposits are not DICGC-insured.
